{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm, as we need it for the mean calculation
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
df_mean = df_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean().reset_index()
df_mean = df_mean.sort_values(by='flipper_length_mm', ascending=False)

# Get the species with the highest mean flipper length
highest_species = df_mean.iloc[0]['species']

# Print the result
highest_species"}
